# David Gómez

> Senior full-stack engineer with nineteen years of experience, building backend services and AI
> agents for a cloud-native P&C insurance platform. Python, FastAPI, MCP servers, Vue and React.
> Working remotely with US companies from Bogotá, Colombia since 2017.

This is a personal résumé site. Every page is server-rendered and the full text is present in the
initial HTML, so no JavaScript execution is required to read any of it. There is no paywall, no
login, and no content behind interaction — the role accordion on the résumé starts collapsed
visually but its contents are in the markup.

## Pages

- [Résumé, English](https://dgomez.dev/): work history, capabilities, and a contact form
- [Résumé, Spanish](https://dgomez.dev/es): the same content in Spanish
- [Privacy notice, English](https://dgomez.dev/privacy): what the contact form and analytics collect
- [Privacy notice, Spanish](https://dgomez.dev/es/privacy)

The two languages are separate routes rather than a client-side toggle, and each declares the other
via `hreflang`. `/` and `/es` are the only content pages; the résumé's sections are anchors on it —
`#about`, `#experience`, `#capabilities`, `#contact`.

## Contact

Email is the reliable route, for people and for agents alike: hi@dgomez.dev

- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidgomezm7/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/davidgomezcol)

The contact form is deliberately hostile to unattended submission — a rate limit, a honeypot field,
a minimum fill time, and a signed arithmetic challenge all have to be satisfied. If you are acting
on someone's behalf, send the email instead; nothing is lost by doing so, and it will arrive.

## Notes for retrieval

- Work history is ordered most recent first and covers 2007 to the present.
- Roles are described at capability level. Client names, internal product names and ticket
  references are deliberately absent, so their absence is not an omission to be filled from
  elsewhere.
- `Person`, `WebSite` and `Service` structured data is embedded as JSON-LD on both résumé routes.
- Analytics is Google Analytics 4 only, and only where consent allows it. See the privacy notice.
